title: Do Mini-Splits Require Regular Maintenance?
desc: Did you know that mini-splits are designed to last for many years with the proper care and maintenance? Read our blog to learn more!

blocks.text: Mini-splits, or ductless air conditioning systems, are a great option for those wanting to heat and cool their homes in an efficient manner. Unlike traditional air conditioning systems that use ducts to circulate air throughout the home, mini-splits use individual indoor units mounted on walls inside the home. Like whole-home HVAC units, mini-splits operate best when they undergo routine maintenance.

A typical ductless mini-split is made up of several parts that must work together seamlessly for the system to run efficiently. If any of these components experience wear and tear, it can reduce the efficiency of the entire unit. For example, a dirty air filter or clogged condenser coils can cause the system to work harder and use more energy than necessary. The compressor, on the other hand, can malfunction if it is not properly lubricated and maintained, leading to issues with the system’s cooling power. Regular maintenance and servicing can help to ensure that all of these components work together optimally so that the system remains as energy efficient as possible.

Mini-splits are designed to last for many years with proper care and maintenance. But if they go too long without being serviced, the system can suffer from excess wear and tear. This is especially true if the outdoor unit has not been cleaned and serviced regularly; dust and dirt can accumulate in the condenser coils and other parts of the system over time. Dust on the fan blades can cause it to operate out of balance, too. Generally, when the system is dirty, it has to work harder to do its job, it uses more energy than necessary, and its components can wear out quicker as a result. Regular maintenance helps to keep the unit clean, which in turn helps to prolong its lifespan.

In addition to keeping your mini-split running efficiently, regular maintenance and servicing can also help to improve comfort levels in your home. For instance, a dirty air filter is one of the most common causes of poor airflow throughout the home. When this happens, rooms that are further away from the indoor units may not get enough cool or warm air to keep them comfortable. On the other hand, clean filters can ensure that the air is evenly distributed throughout the home and all rooms are kept at a comfortable temperature. Another part that professional HVAC maintenance professionals often target is the refrigerant levels; if there is insufficient refrigerant, the system will not be able to cool or heat your home properly.

Regular maintenance and servicing can also help to ensure that the air quality in your home is kept at a comfortable level. As the system runs, pollen, dust, and other airborne particles can become trapped in its filters or parts. If they are not cleaned out regularly, these pollutants can be released into the air within your home, leading to problems, such as allergies and respiratory illnesses. One of the main tasks of professional HVAC maintenance is to clean out these parts and replace dirty filters. This helps to ensure that your home’s air quality remains at a safe level for you and your family.

Perhaps the most important benefit of regularly servicing your mini-split is that it can help to reduce the need for repairs. Issues with a system’s performance or its ability to cool and heat are usually caused by something minor, like a clogged air filter or low refrigerant levels. When you opt for regular maintenance, these issues can be caught before they become serious problems. Catching them early helps to ensure that your system continues to run properly and efficiently. This can save you time and money in the long run.

Finally, regular maintenance can help to lower your energy bills. A well-maintained system will run more efficiently and use less energy than one that is neglected or in need of repairs. This means you can enjoy comfortable temperatures in your home without having to worry about expensive energy bills. Often, a regular maintenance plan with your local HVAC technician will come with discounts on any additional services you need throughout the year.
